title: inspect_wire is a plain tool, and ask reaches a scratch CodeMother launched with her roots
intention: Code outside CodeMother asks build_inspector's judges through a plain tool, cairn/tools/inspect_wire, whose ask reaches a real CodeMother process on a scratch bus, launched by name with her roots set by her environment, never by a write into her.
why: Answering open-bc154232ff80 (2026-11-13), the orchestrator split 4c4addb09adb's remaining gap: inspect_wire lives inside codemother and holds her shim in the asking process, and fixture() writes her inspector's globals, so an outside proof reaches into her twice. Read 2026-11-13 at origin/main 44e86aa7c: inspect_wire lives at cairn/devices/codemother/tools/inspect_wire and its _scratch_bus() holds CodeMotherShim IN the asking process (imports cairn.devices.codemother.shim); fixture() writes the in-process inspector's _CHART_BERTHS, _TICKETS_ROOT and _crossing_roots; the bus process (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py) wakes an addressee by name through DeviceRoster.shim_for and RemoteBus.hold; bus_client.remote._spawn starts a bus process at any home but passes it no environment of the caller's (systemd-run hands the manager's env plus HOME, PATH and CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID). On akiendell, SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Profile) answered C:\Users\akien with USERPROFILE and HOME both set to a fake folder, so the account home is readable apart from HOME on Windows as pwd gives it on POSIX.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 6 (a tool has users); Law 7 (a refusal raises); outline 9.4.3.3.4 (Q#88); ticket d2ecdb867bc9 (a caller may not choose the gate's evidence)
how: D1: THE TOOL. cairn/devices/codemother/tools/inspect_wire/ moves to cairn/tools/inspect_wire/ as a plain tool (a tool has users, Law 6; no device publishes it, so encapsulation_holds has nothing to admit). It keeps wire_encode, wire_decode, InspectRefused and ask(judge, *args, **kwargs) with their signatures, and imports nothing under cairn.devices.codemother. Callers repoint one import line each: codemother's shim, transitions.py (two lines), and the two proofs that import it. D2: THE LAUNCH. scratch_bus.launch(device, env=None) is a context: a scratch HOME (cairn.tools.scratch.scratch_dir), a bus process at that HOME's bus address started through bus_client's ensure_bus with home_env(home, CAIRN_BUS_HOME=<that address>, **env), and device held there by name (RemoteBus.hold), so the bus process wakes it the way the rack does. It yields the RemoteBus and shuts the bus down at exit. bus_client.remote gains env= on ensure_bus, RemoteBus and the three spawns: Popen gets it as its environment, and systemd-run gets a --setenv for each of its keys. D3: THE WORLD BY ENVIRONMENT. inspect_wire.launch(berths=None, tickets_root=None, crossing_roots=None) is a context that starts a scratch CodeMother through scratch_bus.launch with CAIRN_BUILD_INSPECTOR_CHART_BERTHS, CAIRN_BUILD_INSPECTOR_TICKETS_ROOT and CAIRN_BUILD_INSPECTOR_CROSSING_ROOTS (a JSON object of paths) set for the roots it names; every ask inside the block rides it. Outside any block the first ask launches one plain world for the process (closed at exit), so two asks still ride one bus. fixture() and codemother's HELD_HERE go. D4: THE GUARD (the orchestrator, 2026-11-13). The inspector reads those three variables only when its HOME is a scratch HOME, else the live roots stand, so the d2ecdb867bc9 hole does not move into the environment. cairn.tools.scratch gains account_home() (pwd on POSIX, SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Profile) on Windows, never HOME or USERPROFILE) and is_scratch_home() (HOME resolves elsewhere than account_home()). D5: 266d39d56d06's side stays: the inspect verb, INSPECT_JUDGES and the decode on arrival in codemother's shim are untouched but for the import line. D6: PROOFS. cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_an_outside_proof_asks_the_inspector_through_inspect_wire.py moves to cairn/tools/inspect_wire/proofs/test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother.py with 7ea59855b1f4's PROVES keys, its fixture tooth now a launch-world tooth, beside clauses 1-3. cairn/devices/cairn/tools/scratch_bus/proofs/test_a_launched_device_wakes_on_a_scratch_bus.py proves clause 5, cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_bus_spawn_carries_its_launch_env.py the env carry of D2, cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_a_scratch_home_is_told_from_the_account_home.py and cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_the_roots_bend_only_under_a_scratch_home.py clause 4. Teeth that ride a bus need Postgres on 5432; on a box without it the Linux sealer's run is the seal (outline 9.4.8.1). D7: THE WIRE ANSWER'S CONTRACT (the orchestrator's call, 2026-11-13). The bus is JSON, so ask's answer equals the direct answer's JSON-normal form, json.loads(json.dumps(x, default=str)); the codec is not taught to rebuild a returned tuple. The moved tooth compares both sides in that form, and no ask() caller compares a result to a tuple literal (grep over the corpus). ask answers from a CodeMother held by a bus process that is not the asking process, woken by name, and the asking process never imports codemother's shim

inside launch(berths=, tickets_root=, crossing_roots=) a judge asked over ask reads the roots named, set by the scratch CodeMother's launch environment; after the block its bus answers nothing; fixture is gone
